alternate_mechanisms.name: contained_recitation_vs_discarded_matter
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Pasture becomes gathered, low-value matter that can be carried away, whereas revealed speech is gathered into recitation, held, and explicitly protected from forgetting or abandonment. This sharpens the preservation contrast already present in the clause sequence.

alternate_mechanisms.name: measured_yield_and_allotted_provision
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Determination becomes measured allocation; pasture emerges as yield and provision, acquires allotted value, and is delivered as benefaction to a household or dependent community. Commerce and inheritance details remain analogical.

alternate_mechanisms.name: guided_pastoral_mobility
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The pasture scene includes working livestock, leading anatomy, rein and staff control, riding equipment, and portable storage. This gives فَهَدَىٰ a concrete ecological analogue: creatures and resources are fitted for directed movement through their habitat.

alternate_mechanisms.name: call_reception_and_transmission
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The opening command initiates an addressed exchange: a call is intentionally oriented, attentively received, formulated as sacred speech, and conveyed through recitation. This preserves the interpersonal speech mechanics surrounding the divine promise.

alternate_mechanisms.name: formed_disposition_guided_or_departing
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Creation includes formed disposition and aptitude; proportion gives orientation; guidance supplies the intended course. Departure from origin or obedience and abandonment are the negative possibilities excluded by continuous lordly care.

alternate_mechanisms.name: household_nurture_and_entrusted_provision
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Lordship appears as staged nurture of dependents, guided transfer into care, pastoral provision, and preservation of what is entrusted. The same care that sustains a household and herd supplies the relational model for recitation not being neglected.

alternate_mechanisms.name: cosmic_rotation_and_appointed_recitation
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Coursing and circular form become celestial and seasonal cycles; lasting, approach, delay, and appointed time then frame سَنُقْرِئُكَ as an event placed within the same measured temporal order as weather and growth. Biological and legal cycle details remain tertiary.
